title: Piercing Statue Trio #026 (쓰리쿼터 · [쓰리쿼터·P25 집중형·시트린·메이크업 웨이쉰] ; [쓰리쿼터·P50 정의형·아쿠아마린·메이크업 걸크러시] ; [쓰리쿼터·P8 집중형·ebony·메이크업 만바])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue portrait. THREE women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman — clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge rose-gold hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide rose-gold ear cuff, three smaller rose-gold rings, two thick rose-gold bars and a small rose-gold stud up to the top; one small rose-gold stud sits in the right ear; four thin rose-gold bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small rose-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick rose-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a rose-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a rose-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small rose-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a rose-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a rose-gold labret stud and a small rose-gold ring sit on the chin; three small rose-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces.
#1 Physique: A colossal chest, a waist that pulls in sharply beneath it, wide flaring hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid transparent material, solid golden-yellow citrine crystal, with faint feathery inclusions and colour zoning, deep honey-gold where thickest and pale lemon at every thin edge, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman — fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in twin-tail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick rose-gold septum ring with a smaller rose-gold ring above it and two rose-gold rings through each nostril; a straight rose-gold bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick rose-gold bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a rose-gold Medusa stud above the lips; a big rose-gold hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a rose-gold labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small rose-gold studs along each jaw; a curved row of small rose-gold studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized rose-gold hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine rose-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#2 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid transparent material, solid clear sea-blue aquamarine crystal, with long fine needle-like tubes at depth and clean facets, deep teal where thickest and pale sea-blue at every thin edge, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

#3: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#3 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge mixed-metal drop dangle hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, two smaller mixed-metal rings and a small mixed-metal stud at the top; two thin mixed-metal bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small mixed-metal ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces.
#3 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#3 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque wood, solid deep black ebony wood, densely fine-grained, polished to a hard, glass-like satin sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm rose pink on one side and a soft cream on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
